reasoning: 驗證 $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ 收到 6 時，TLM 顯示對應之拒絕進入 Service Mode popup 並重設 T_EPB_MM。關鍵情境為單一回饋值之等價類。本 Req 只述一個 Fdbk 值，依 §8.2.2 一 Req 一條，不與其他 Fdbk 值合併。該訊號 v3 解得，惟 DBC 之 VAL_ 1486 只定義 0 與 31，值 6 無 label，依 IN §8.4.1 不造 label，寫 = 6 並於 Remarks 揭露。

tcs.tc_title: EPB Maintenance feedback = 6: Brake pedal is currently pressed
pre_conditions: The EPB Maintenance Mode menu item is displayed
The TLM is in the Vehicle Settings menu
test_procedure: Read the named UI element "Brake pedal is currently pressed" and check that it is displayed
Read the signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ and check that it is 6
expected_result: The signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ = 6 is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Brake pedal is currently pressed" is displayed
tcs.test_item:
When TLM receives the value "6" via signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$, TLM shall activate and display the popup indicating that the user selected Yes to enter Service Mode, but the brake pedal is currently pressed
(Fdbk = 6: entry refused because the brake pedal is pressed)

distinguishing_axis.delta: Fdbk 值 6（煞車踏板踩下），與同族其他 Fdbk 值為等價類之不同分割

tcs.remarks: DBC has no VAL_ entry for this raw value (VAL_ 1486 EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk defines 0 and 31 only), so no label is written
